definitions.content:
Each partial range (index i=1,2,...) is defined by:

- its verification scale interval, $ e_{i}, e_{i+1} > e_{i} $;

- its maximum capacity, $ \mathrm{M a x}_{i} $ ; and

- its minimum capacity, $ \mathrm{M i n}_{i}=\mathrm{M a x}_{i-1} $ (for $ i=1 $ , the minimum capacity is $ \mathrm{M i n}_{1}=\mathrm{M i n} $ ).

The number of verification scale intervals, $ n_{i} $ , for each partial range is equal to $ \operatorname{M a x}_{i} / e_{i}. $
